content.content: User wants list of Premier League 2023/24 season football teams based in London and their home stadiums. Need to provide list. Should verify teams in PL 2023/24 that are London-based: Arsenal (Emirates Stadium), Chelsea (Stamford Bridge), Tottenham Hotspur (Tottenham Hotspur Stadium), West Ham United (London Stadium), Crystal Palace (Selhurst Park), Brentford (Brentford Community Stadium), Fulham (Craven Cottage). Also maybe? That's all London clubs in PL 2023/24. Check if any other like Bournemouth not London. So answer list. Provide maybe table. Ensure accuracy. No external tool needed.

content:
**Premier League 2023/24 – London‑based clubs and their home stadiums**

| Club | Home Stadium | Stadium Capacity* |
|------|--------------|-------------------|
| Arsenal | Emirates Stadium (London, Holloway) | ~60,260 |
| Brentford | Brentford Community Stadium (Brentford, West London) | ~17,250 |
| Chelsea | Stamford Bridge (Fulham, South‑West London) | ~40,341 |
| Crystal Palace | Selhurst Park (South Norwood, South‑London) | ~25,486 |
| Fulham | Craven Cottage (Fulham, South‑West London) | ~19,200 |
| Tottenham Hotspur | Tottenham Hotspur Stadium (Tottenham, North‑London) | ~62,850 |
| West Ham United | London Stadium (Stratford, East‑London) | ~60,000 (football configuration) |

\*Capacities are approximate and reflect the typical all‑seated numbers used for Premier League matches in the 2023/24 season.  

These are the seven clubs that were based in Greater London and competed in the Premier League for the 2023/24 campaign.
